panelia.title: What is Panelia?
panelia.body: Panelia is a personal widget-based start page. You can choose which widgets you want to use, place them where you want, and adjust the appearance so the dashboard becomes your own. You build your own start page.

points.signIn: Sign in to start placing widgets, save your layout, and sync preferences.
points.addWidgets: Open the edit panel on the left and add the widgets you want.
points.aiHjelp: Use the AI assistant to change the page appearance more efficiently.
points.moveResize: Drag and resize widgets to build a good workflow layout. Drag the widget's bottom-right corner to resize it, and drag anywhere without content, for example along the edge, to move it.
points.customize: Change theme, colors, and font size in settings. Make your page look great and unique!

points.weather: The weather widget gives you a quick overview of current conditions.
points.calendar: The calendar widget helps you keep track of plans and deadlines.
points.news: The news widget fetches updated headlines in seconds.
points.notes: The notes widget makes it easy to capture ideas and reminders.

project.title: About the project
project.body: Panelia was developed as a bachelor project to explore design, frontend architecture, and integration with third-party services. Thank you for using Panelia!

points.team: We are Audun, Sindre, Jonas, and Einar, from the University of South-Eastern Norway.
